rationale: This is a motor vehicle collision with comprehensive damage (totaled vehicle) and bodily injury to the policyholder from a rear-end impact.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan was rear-ended at a red light on Route 9 yesterday at 8:15 AM by a vehicle traveling ~35 mph with no braking; the car is totaled with trunk crushed into the back seat. Policyholder sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist. Police report filed with other driver's insurance information included.

case_facts.description: rear-ended by other vehicle traveling ~35 mph with no braking; trunk crushed into back seat

rationale: A tree from the policyholder's own property fell on their parked vehicle, causing damage to the hood and windshield; this is a comprehensive auto loss (weather/falling object damage) clearly covered under auto insurance.
claim_summary: Policyholder Riley Kim reports a mature maple tree from their front yard blown down by wind and landing on their parked vehicle, causing damage to the hood and windshield. This is a comprehensive auto loss with estimated structural damage likely exceeding $5,000; requires prompt assessment and vehicle inspection.

case_facts.description: maple tree blown down by wind, landed on parked car
